disciplinary_grounds.description: Civil penalty may be imposed for violation of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 or rules adopted thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Electrical and Elevator Board may impose a civil penalty for a violation of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 or rules adopted for the administration or enforcement of ORS 479.510 to 479.945 and this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: No person shall make, supervise or direct an electrical installation that does not meet minimum safety standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall make, supervise or direct the making of an electrical installation which does not meet minimum safety standards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Installing an uncertified electrical product in connection with business is prohibited.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a person may not install an electrical product in connection with the person's business unless the product is certified under ORS 479.760.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obstructing or interfering with the department in performance of its duties is prohibited.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person may not obstruct or interfere with the department in performance of any of the department's duties or the exercise of any authority conferred under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removing, transferring, altering or tampering with an inspection permit, label, tag or other indicia of inspection is prohibited.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall remove, transfer, alter or otherwise tamper with an inspection permit, label, tag or other indicia of inspection placed on or at an electrical job site, electrical installation or electrical product.

disciplinary_grounds.description: No person shall work on any new electrical installation for which a permit has not been issued.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person shall work on any new electrical installation for which a permit has not been issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A licensing board may consider criminal convictions or substantially related conduct in determining fitness to hold a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a licensing board, commission or agency may deny an occupational or professional license or impose discipline on a licensee based on conduct that is not undertaken directly in the course of the licensed activity, but that is substantially related to the fitness and ability of the applicant or licensee to engage in the activity for which the license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may not issue license if practical experience qualification is based on training or experience in another state not equivalent to Oregon standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may not administer an examination to, and the Department of Consumer and Business Services may not issue any license to, a person whose practical experience qualification for the license is based upon training or experience in another state if the board determines that the training or experience is not equivalent to the standards for electrical training programs prescribed in this state.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical installations" means the construction or installation of electrical wiring and the permanent attachment or installation of electrical products in or on any structure that is not itself an electrical product. "Electrical installation" also means the maintenance or repair of installed electrical wiring and permanently attached electrical products.
